result.title: MedICL: Modality-Anatomy-Aware Visual In-Context Learning for Medical Visual Question Answering
result.summary: Training-free adaptation of medical vision-language models (LVLMs) is a deployment requirement, yet visual in-context learning (ICL) injects modality- and style-mismatched demonstrations into medical contexts, teaching a frozen model the wrong answering style. We present MedICL, which curates demonstrations instead of retraining the model. MADS selects modality-anatomy aligned demonstrations that cover complementary interpretation dimensions; W2C curates them with weak retrieval signals and a strong verification vote that checks demonstrations rather than the model's own outputs; ECC answers with W anchored demonstration sets, aggregates by abnormality-aware signatures, and re-answers once on conflict. On VQA-RAD, SLAKE, and PathVQA under the LLaVA-Med zero-shot protocol, MedICL improves the strongest zero-shot baseline by +11 - +14 points on open-ended and +7 - +14 on closed questions, recovers 71% of fine-tuned open-ended performance on VQA-RAD at zero training cost, and stays robust to shifted or corrupted demonstration banks.

AI.brief_summary: MedICL 提出免训练的医学 VQA 自适应方案：不重训模型，而是用 MADS 挑选模态-解剖对齐、覆盖互补解读维度的 in-context 示例，再用弱检索信号加「检查示例而非模型自身输出」的强验证投票进行筛选，并以异常感知签名聚合、冲突时重答一次；在 VQA-RAD、SLAKE、PathVQA 的 LLaVA-Med 零样本设定下显著提升开/闭式准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「弱检索+强验证投票、冲突触发一次重答」的免训练证据筛选与复核机制，可能可供核查为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选及停止决策的借鉴线索；但论文本身是医学 VQA 的上下文示例挑选与部署适配，未涉及 latent 推理状态的生成或更新。
